title: M1.9: Sandbox live proof, acceptance check and runbook
description:
Owner verifies one test address as an SES identity (verification email from SES, no Amazon request). In development: send a real email to a bot address, see the turn and the threaded reply arrive; send replies from the verified address; run the simulator success and bounce sends. Add the external-email check to conversation/bin/acceptance.ts (recorded raw message through the ingress test entry point under a dedicated test tenant, success simulator send expects sent, bounce simulator expects bounced). Write the runbook with read-only AWS commands that never print account ids or secret values.

Acceptance criteria:
- The live round trip is demonstrated and recorded on the Kanbus task with message ids but no addresses of third parties
- Acceptance runner check passes against development
- Runbook lists sandbox limits, what production access would unlock and the owner-gated request
- No request was filed with Amazon; no GitHub settings changed

Gherkin: none (infrastructure or owner task); infra tests or a runbook are the evidence.

Depends on: M1.8; owner action: verify the test address

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).
